Subject: Quick follow-up — 30m intro & suggested stakeholder slots

Hi Jordan and Priya,

Thanks again for the time earlier — good conversation and useful context on the analytics pipeline and ePHI routing constraints. A quick recap from our side:
- Primary goal: reduce token costs for long-form patient summary generation while staying within your latency SLOs.
- Key constraints: on-prem data residency for PHI-derived prompts, strict audit logs, and a dedicated inference pool for nightly batch jobs.

Next step I suggest is a 30-minute intro/demo with our product + a short tech orientation for your infra lead. That will be a high-level walkthrough focused on: architecture fit, expected latency/cost tradeoffs, and the ops controls (routing, KV cache, canary rollouts).

Would any of these 30-minute windows work for your team next week (all PT)?
1) Wednesday May 11, 10:00–10:30
2) Thursday May 12, 14:00–14:30
3) Friday May 13, 08:30–09:00

If none of these fit, send 2–3 times that do and we’ll adapt. Also please flag which Synapse stakeholders you want on the call (arch/infra, product owner, security/compliance). I’ve attached a 2-page demo brief and a one-sheet mutual action plan to help identify decision owners.

Attachments: redwood-demo-brief.pdf, MutualActionPlan.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll coordinate calendar invites once you confirm a slot and attendees.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
